dish.title: Maple Mustard Glazed Salmon
dish.name: Maple Mustard Glazed Salmon
dish.description: Salmon fillets and asparagus brushed with Dijon and maple syrup and roasted until the salmon is opaque at the center.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: Maple Mustard Glazed Salmon
recipe_version.description: Salmon fillets and asparagus brushed with Dijon and maple syrup and roasted until the salmon is opaque at the center.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.heat: Oven 400 F on a sheet pan.
recipe_version.doneness: Salmon is done when opaque at the center, 12 to 15 minutes at 400 F. That is cooked through, not rare and not a medium-rare center. Asparagus is tender at the same time.

ingredients.name: salmon fillets
ingredients.note: About 6 oz each, 1.5 lb total. Drafter weight. v1 said only 4. Skin-on or skinless as sold. Not a steak and not a whole side.

ingredients.name: Dijon mustard
ingredients.note: Store-bought. Not a dairy food and not an allergen token in this catalog.

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.note: Maple syrup, not pancake syrup. v1 mixes it into the glaze. The glaze step refs omitted it.

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.note: About 1 lb. Drafter weight. v1 said 1 bunch.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.body: Heat the oven to 400 F. Mix the Dijon and the maple syrup. Brush it on the salmon and the asparagus. No oil is listed, and none is added.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Roast on a sheet pan at 400 F for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon is opaque at the center and the asparagus is tender. Opaque at the center means cooked through, not rare.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Dairy-free. Dijon and maple syrup are not dairy. Not plant and not vegetarian. fish and finfish are not dietary labels. No wheat ingredient is listed. Gluten-free is not claimed.
allergen_notes: Dijon is not an allergen token here and it is not dairy.
No egg, milk, soy, wheat, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, or shellfish in the named foods.
